newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson expects to win consent recount.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson expects to win consent recount.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson Co believes a recount of its solicitation of consents of Great Western Financial Corp shareholders will certify that its third, fourth and fifth proposals were approved, an Ahmanson spokesman said on Friday.
Great Western and Ahmanson both asked for the recount, Great Western said earlier.
Ahmanson's spokesman said while 5.2 million shares were voted twice in favor of its proposals, only 3.8 million of those shares were included in an earlier tabulation by indpendent inspectors.

The original count showed Ahmanson as having won on the three proposals. After Ahmanson launched a bid for Great Western in February, Great Western signed a merger agreement with Washington Mutual Inc.
Ahmanson's third proposal calls for the Great Western bylaws to be amended to require that the company's annual meeting be held on the fourth Tuesday in April or within 14 days of that date.

The fourth proposal calls for an amendment to the Great Western bylaws to provide that holders of a majority of the stock having voting power -- whether in person or by proxy -- shall constitute a quorum.
The fifth proposal would amend the bylaws to prevent any of the other consents that are approved from being amended or repealed without an affirmative vote by a majority of the shareholders.
